summary: Enhance your NGO's efficiency with our Logistics and Supply Chain Management training course. Learn essential skills to optimize operations and impact.
lede: Logistics and Supply Chain Management for NGOs helps teams connect demand planning, ethical procurement, inventory control, warehouse operations, transport coordination, and performance reporting. Using SCOR, ISO 31000, Incoterms 2020, and practical Excel workflows, participants learn to strengthen reliability despite uncertain demand, limited budgets, changing access conditions, and incomplete data. The course includes hands-on work to map a supply chain, calculate inventory indicators, prepare procurement schedules, assess suppliers, document transport risks, and design a Power BI-ready dashboard. It also introduces ISO 20400, the Sphere Handbook, and the Core Humanitarian Standard at an applied overview level, leaving participants with an adaptable action plan for improving availability, accountability, and resource stewardship.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate NGO procurement, warehousing, transport, programme supply, and operational accountability. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a practical operating view rather than specialist training in customs law, advanced analytics, or enterprise software implementation.
modules: SCOR Foundations for NGO Supply Chains
Demand Planning and Supply Chain Data
prerequisites: Prior NGO, humanitarian, development, procurement, warehousing, transport, or programme operations exposure is useful but not mandatory. You should be comfortable with basic tables and arithmetic; no coding or programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted demand analysis are introduced at conceptual and operational application level, not production implementation level.
